Bash(cd /c/Code/vaani && C:/Tools/bd.exe create \\
  --title "HIGH: RTMPStreamer.audioQueue unbounded — OOM under sustained load" \\
  --description "## src/lib/rtmp-streamer.ts:322-340\\n\\npushAudio\(\) enqueues PCM buffers with no size limit. The 100ms drain loop writes a fixed 4800 bytes/tick, so under TTS burst conditions the queue grows without bound → OOM kills the server.\\n\\n## Fix\\nBound the queue \(e.g. cap at N MB or N chunks\); drop oldest + log warning when full." \\
  --label bug,high 2>&1)

Bash(cd /c/Code/vaani && C:/Tools/bd.exe create \\
  --title "HIGH: In-flight pipeline keeps running after stopSession \(race condition\)" \\
  --description "## server.ts:173-94\\n\\ndrainPipelineQueue holds a reference to the pipeline state object. After stopSession + clearPipelineState delete it from the Map, the old drain loop keeps running on the stale reference. New audio creates a second drain loop → two loops processing chunks simultaneously, out-of-order translations, audio pushed to wrong streamer.\\n\\n## Fix\\nUse a per-session generation/epoch counter or AbortSignal so in-flight pipeline work is cancelled/bailed on session stop." \\
  --label bug,high 2>&1)

  --description "## src/app/\(dashboard\)/DashboardShell.tsx:90-116\\n\\nThe cleanup function is returned from inside .then\(\), NOT from the useEffect callback. React never sees it.
